    Serialized Form

    • Package info.jeffkerns.taskmanager.entity

      • Class info.jeffkerns.taskmanager.entity.UserEntity

        class UserEntity extends Object implements Serializable

        • Serialized Fields

          • createdAt
            Instant createdAt
            Timestamp when the user record was initially created. updatable = false ensures Hibernate will never include this column in UPDATE statements.
          • email
            String email
            Unique email address for notifications and identification (max 250 characters).
          • id
            Long id
            Primary Key identifier. Auto-generated by the database identity/sequence on insertion.
          • passwordHash
            String passwordHash
            Salted BCrypt password hash. NEVER store plain-text passwords in this field!
          • role
            UserRole role
            User's system role (e.g. USER, ADMIN). @JdbcTypeCode(SqlTypes.NAMED_ENUM) tells Hibernate to map this Java enum to PostgreSQL's native tasks.user_role custom enum type.
          • tasks
            List<TaskEntity> tasks
            All tasks owned by this user.
            • cascade = CascadeType.ALL: If a user is deleted, their tasks are also deleted.
            • orphanRemoval = true: If a task is removed from this list, delete it from the DB.
            • fetch = FetchType.LAZY: Only load tasks when accessed.
          • updatedAt
            Instant updatedAt
            Timestamp when the user record was last modified.
          • username
            String username
            Unique username for login (max 30 characters).
